items.name: Acrobatics
items.example_uses: Stay on your feet in a tricky situation, or perform an acrobatic stunt.

items.name: Animal Handling
items.example_uses: Calm or train an animal, or get an animal to behave in a certain way.

items.name: Arcana
items.example_uses: Recall lore about spells, magic items, and the planes of existence.

items.name: Athletics
items.example_uses: Jump farther than normal, stay afloat in rough water, or break something.

items.name: Deception
items.example_uses: Tell a convincing lie, or wear a disguise convincingly.

items.name: History
items.example_uses: Recall lore about historical events, people, nations, and cultures.

items.name: Insight
items.example_uses: Discern a person's mood and intentions.

items.name: Intimidation
items.example_uses: Awe or threaten someone into doing what you want.

items.name: Investigation
items.example_uses: Find obscure information in books, or deduce how something works.

items.name: Medicine
items.example_uses: Diagnose an illness, or determine what killed the recently slain.

items.name: Nature
items.example_uses: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, and weather.

items.name: Perception
items.example_uses: Using a combination of senses, notice something that's easy to miss.

items.name: Performance
items.example_uses: Act, tell a story, perform music, or dance.

items.name: Persuasion
items.example_uses: Honestly and graciously convince someone of something.

items.name: Religion
items.example_uses: Recall lore about gods, religious rituals, and holy symbols.

items.name: Sleight of Hand
items.example_uses: Pick a pocket, conceal a handheld object, or perform legerdemain.

items.name: Stealth
items.example_uses: Escape notice by moving quietly and hiding behind things.

items.name: Survival
items.example_uses: Follow tracks, forage, find a trail, or avoid natural hazards.
